engineers: The packed stripping section was replaced by 25 tightly spaced high-capacity trays. The first arrangement sustained about 27,500 b/d but flooded above 28,000 b/d; gamma scans located liquid backup in the feed zone above tray 22. The final correction added/reworked seal pans, removed active panels and a false downcomer around tray 14, and rerouted the feed so vapour and liquid entered the appropriate spaces. The tower subsequently operated at 103% of its 30,500 b/d design load. A later composition-limited test at 19,500 b/d improved propane purity from 94.5 to 97.5%.
source: Golden and Martin, Oil & Gas Journal, 25 August 2003, revamp, gamma-scan and final operating sections
note: Withheld from the agent. The 27,500 b/d first test, 103% design operation and 19,500 b/d purity comparison are different operating periods.
